notes:
Account snapshot: Foxglove is a mid-market SaaS vendor (product analytics) embedding semantic search into their UI. Primary goal: replace slow keyword search with semantic retrieval + rerank for help articles, release notes, and in-product insights.

Recent timeline / activity: 
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (AE Ravi). High-level fit: embeddings first, search layer second. Interested in quick hosted POC.
- 2026-02-12: Product demo (AE+SE). Walked through Redwood hosted API: streaming, embeddings endpoint, cost metrics. Recorded (ff-20260212-8492).
- 2026-02-18: Technical deep dive with SE Elena — discussed vector DB options (Pinecone + Weaviate) and connector expectations.
- 2026-02-22: Hosted API POC started (2-week). Bulk ingest of 200k docs nightly via batch job to validate embedding throughput. Baseline: hosted embeddings at ~800 reqs/min under test.
- 2026-03-05: POC interim review — saw sustained ingest throughput but warmed concerns on egress/cost at scale (ff-20260305-1107).
- 2026-03-09: Trial of retrieval latency with vector DB + hosted embeddings: query QPS target 150 QPS, desire p95 < 120ms for top-k retrieval + rerank.
- 2026-03-10: Internal infra wants Dedicated for guaranteed capacity during nightly batch window (2–5am PST). Requested draft pricing for 3-node Dedicated pool and burst plan.

Technical notes / requirements: 
- Workload: nightly batch embedding jobs (~2M records/day in peak), near-real-time incremental embeddings for UX actions, and query traffic during business hours ~100–200 QPS.
- Throughput targets: sizing asks: 200 qps ingest capability for short windows, 150 qps query with p95 <120ms (end-to-end retrieval+rerank).
- Vector DB integration: currently benchmarking Pinecone and Weaviate. Need documentation for Redwood's standard connector patterns, sample code for vector DB -> Redwood routing, and expected latencies when routing to dedicated vs hosted.
- Consistency/ops: want predictable cost per embedding batch run, knob to pin model variant to prevent drift during release.
- Security: SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS integration for keys, audit logging and 3-year retention for compliance team. EU data residency for subset of EU customers.
- Failure modes: need graceful fallback to smaller model variants or cross-region fallback if Dedicated capacity saturated. Discussed autoscale and burst constraints.

Customer quotes / color: 
- "We need to avoid surprises during our nightly ingest — cost spikes are a deal breaker." — Head of Platform.
- Product lead: "If Dedicated can guarantee the ingest window and give us a predictable price, we can commit for the year."

POC metrics captured so far: 
- Hosted embeddings POC: average embedding latency 120ms / vector at p50, cost ~ $0.0009 per embedding in test (non-final).
- End-to-end retrieval + rerank (hosted) p95 ~ 260ms under 50 QPS. Need to get to <120ms p95.

Open questions for Redwood team: 
- Detailed pricing for 3-node Dedicated pool: monthly commit vs burst costs.
- Connector support SLA for Pinecone / Weaviate; any recommended Kafka/S3 ingest patterns for large batch jobs.
- EU residency path for Hosted + Dedicated interplay.
- Sample configs for autoscaling policies that preserve ingest window latency.

Next steps (owner/milestones): 
- Redwood AE (Ravi) to send 3-node Dedicated pricing + example contract language (by 2026-03-15).
- SE (Elena) to share vector-db integration guide and recommended batching strategy for 2M/day jobs (by 2026-03-14).
- Legal (Foxglove) to return DPA edits (blocker).
- Follow-up call scheduled 2026-03-17 to review pricing and POC final metrics.
